name: magi-view
description: Shows Magi peer traffic in plain words: peer messages as a header line (who sent it, which card, which round) over their body without the protocol text, your own Magi tool calls as one line each with their delivery state, the /magi deck (what waits on you first, the MAGI triad of claude, codex and omp with the cards in flight moving between them, every agent working on a card as a two-line row grouped by the session that asked, the last messages threaded by card, a seven-day ledger by direction, the providers and the machines beyond this one with their workers, drawn in a Nerd Font on the desktop; a message that carried files names them), a line above the prompt only while something needs you, and peer presence on the status line. Drawing only: the stored messages and what the model reads are unchanged.

checkout.title: Magi checkout
checkout.description: The Magi folder holding bin/magi.mjs, for a copy of the mod that does not sit in claude-mod/ of that folder. Empty: the folder above the mod.

font.title: Deck font
font.description: The monospace the deck's panels are drawn in on the desktop, VS Code and mobile (installed on this machine; a Nerd Font for the icons). The terminal uses its own font.

icons.title: Nerd Font icons
icons.description: Draw the deck's icons with the font's Nerd Font glyphs; off, plain Unicode marks, for a font without them.

openOnStart.title: Open the deck on start
openOnStart.description: Open the Magi deck when a session starts (Claude Code seats a pane nobody asked for from 144 columns); /magi opens it at any width.
